visual_logic.composition: Square format. On the LEFT, 'dino_bones_paleontologist_1' (older male, white beard, glasses) holds out a large, glowing white Magnolia flower with an encouraging smile. On the RIGHT, the three Jurassic dinosaurs form a wall of rejection. The Apatosaurus is leaning its long neck far back away from the flower; the Stegosaurus has its head low, looking suspicious and skeptical; the Allosaurus is behind them, arms crossed and eyes rolled, completely uninterested in the 'newfangled' Cretaceous plant.
visual_logic.ground: Damp, light brown earth with a few Jurassic fern fronds scattered around.
visual_logic.background: A lush forest of ancient cycads and ginkgos, contrasting with the 'modern' Magnolia being offered.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, high-key outdoor daylight, highlighting the vibrant white of the 'alien' Magnolia flower.
